_note: Every line Lavi speaks. tools/voice/record.js turns these into audio/lavi/<id>.mp3 and src/js/late/99-zzzzzzzzz-s5-lavi-voice.js. The subtitle may be richer than the spoken words: {name} and numbers appear in text only, because a recording cannot say a player's own name. say = what is spoken, when it differs from text.

hello.text: Oh! You're finally here, {name}! Welcome to Rootbound!
hello.say: Oh! You're finally here! Welcome to Rootbound!

intro2.text: I'm Lavi. I'm going to help you become one of the strongest adventurers here.

tour_profile.text: This is your character. Open it, and I'll show you who you are so far.

tour_profile_ok.text: That's you! Your level, your health, and how far you've come.

tour_inventory.text: Everything you find lands in your bag. Go on, take a peek inside.

tour_inventory_ok.text: See? Click any item, and it tells you exactly what it's for.

tour_equipment.text: Armour, wings and accessories go here. Try opening your equipment.

tour_equipment_ok.text: Lovely! Better gear means more health, and harder hits.

tour_hotbar.text: These are your weapon slots. Press a number key, or scroll, to swap what you're holding.

tour_hotbar_ok.text: Perfect! Your class is simply the class of the weapon in your hand.

tour_cp.text: See that number next to your character? That's your Combat Power! It tells you how strong you really are.

tour_cp2.text: Want to know a little secret? Your weapon is the most important way to raise it. Click it to see why.

tour_cp_ok.text: Every point comes from something real. Nothing is hidden from you here.

tour_skills.text: Each level gives you skill points. Spend them here on the things you like best.

tour_skills_ok.text: You can come back whenever you have more to spend.

tour_classes.text: There are thirteen classes, and each one fights its own way. Have a look!

tour_classes_ok.text: Every class can become just as strong. So pick the one you love!

tour_worlds.text: This is how you travel. Every world hides monsters, treasure and secrets.

tour_worlds_ok.text: So many places to see! We'll get there, one step at a time.

tour_quests.text: Quests pay you in gems and experience. They're the fastest way to level up early on.

tour_quests_ok.text: Finish a few of these, and you'll grow really quickly.

tour_store.text: The store sells weapons and gear. Gems are all you ever need here, and you earn them just by playing.

tour_store_ok.text: A better weapon is a great first purchase, once you can afford one.

tour_dungeon.text: Now, the exciting part. Open the dungeons!

tour_dungeon2.text: Each dungeon has its own entry requirements. The first one needs level ten, and two hundred Combat Power. Both are important!

tour_rewards.text: Look at these materials! They're not just collectibles. Click one, and see what it does.

tour_rewards_ok.text: Now you know exactly what it's for, and where to farm more.

tour_enhance.text: This is the forge. You can make your weapon stronger, using materials and a few gems. Open it!

tour_enhance_ok.text: It always shows you the exact price, and how much stronger you'll get. An upgrade can never fail.

tour_achievements.text: Achievements pay gems too, so little goals are always worth finishing.

tour_settings.text: And if I ever talk too much, you can turn my voice down or off in here.

tour_settings_ok.text: Hehe, I won't be offended. Promise.

tour_end.text: Now you know the secret! Clear dungeons, collect materials, earn gems, enhance your weapon, and watch your Combat Power rise!

tour_end2.text: If you ever wonder what to do next, just click me. I'll always have an idea.

stronger.text: To get stronger, your weapon comes first. Enhance it, buy a better one, and level up your class.

stronger2.text: Better gear helps as well, and every level you gain makes you hit harder.

almost.text: You're almost ready! You just need a little more Combat Power.

need_level.text: You need a few more levels first. Quests and monsters are the quickest way.

need_both.text: Not quite yet. Let's get you some levels, and a stronger weapon.

need_clear.text: You'll need to finish the dungeon before this one first.

ready.text: Your next challenge is waiting! You're strong enough for this dungeon.

can_upgrade.text: Good news! You can already afford an upgrade. Let's go to the forge!

farm_mats.text: You need more materials for your next upgrade. I know just where to find them.

farm_gems.text: You're a little short on gems. Quests, levels and dungeons all pay well.

better_weapon.text: A stronger weapon would really help you right now. Let's check the store.

all_done.text: Wow, you've done everything! You really are one of the strongest now.

upgraded.text: Yay! Your weapon just got stronger!

unlocked.text: You did it! A new dungeon is open for you!

cleared.text: You won! That was amazing! Let's see what you found.

levelup.text: Level up! You're getting stronger already.

welcome_back.text: Welcome back! I missed you. Click me if you want an idea of what to do next.

offer.text: Hi there! I'm Lavi. Would you like a quick tour of what's new?

skipped.text: No problem! I'll be here if you need me.

st_silence.text: Long ago, travelers walked the Rootways between every world. Then the Great Silence came, and the roads went quiet.

st_w1_letters.text: Look! The flowers here grow in the shapes of letters. I think this world is trying to say its name.

st_word.text: You spoke its word! Can you hear that? This world just remembered itself.

st_guard_root.text: Thornmaw was only guarding the roots from thieves... and we looked like thieves. It can rest now.

st_guard_pyre.text: Vulkhar kept the forges burning alone for a hundred years. Pride is a heavy thing to carry.

st_guard_nyx.text: Nyx ate the dying stars so their light would not go to waste. Now new ones can grow.

st_guard_mael.text: Maelor held that city's last song for so long. Listen... the sea is singing again.

st_guard_prism.text: Aurelia froze the festival so it would never end. But festivals are meant to end, so they can happen again!

st_dungeon_first.text: Every dungeon is an old Rootway, buried deep. Whoever guarded it... the Silence changed them.

st_shadow.text: That was only its shadow? Then what is waiting at the very bottom?

st_end.text: Even when worlds drift apart, the moments we share still leave something behind. Thank you for remembering.

st_end_a.text: Do you remember the first thing you heard, when you woke up? The roots. You were the only one who could hear them.

st_end_b.text: My world was the first one it swallowed. I could not remember it... until now. It had blue grass. Isn't that silly?

st_end_d.text: Come on. The festival is starting, and Tobi has already burnt the bread.
